  • Method Details

    • createTable

      public void createTable()
      Creates the users table if it does not already exist and adds any newer columns that may be missing from an older database schema.

    • insert

      public void insert(User user)
      Inserts a new user row into the database and writes the generated primary key back into the User object.
      Parameters:
      user - the User to insert; its id field is updated on success

    • update

      public void update(User user)
      Updates the stored profile values (username, password, hands played, wins, balance) for the user identified by their database id.
      Parameters:
      user - the User whose record should be updated

    • updateCurrentBalance

      public void updateCurrentBalance(int userId, int currentBalance)
      Updates only the chip balance for the user with the given id. Prefer this over update(User) when only the balance has changed, to avoid accidentally overwriting newer statistics.
      Parameters:
      userId - the primary key of the user to update
      currentBalance - the new balance value to store

    • incrementTotalWins

      public void incrementTotalWins(int userId)
      Atomically increments the totalWins counter for the user with the given id directly in the database, avoiding stale in-memory state issues.
      Parameters:
      userId - the primary key of the user whose win count should be incremented

    • delete

      public void delete(int id)
      Deletes the user row with the given id from the database.
      Parameters:
      id - the primary key of the user to delete

    • getAll

      public List<User> getAll()
      Retrieves every row from the users table as a list of User objects.
      Returns:
      a list of all users; empty if the table contains no rows

    • getById

      public User getById(int id)
      Retrieves a single user by their database id.
      Parameters:
      id - the primary key to search for
      Returns:
      the matching User, or null if no row with that id exists

    • getByUsername

      public User getByUsername(String username)
      Retrieves a single user by their username.
      Parameters:
      username - the username to search for (case-sensitive)
      Returns:
      the matching User, or null if the username is not registered

    • getOrCreate

      public User getOrCreate(String username, String password, int defaultBalance)
      Returns an existing account matching the given username, or creates and inserts a new minimal user record if none is found.
      Parameters:
      username - the username to look up or create
      password - the password to assign to a newly created user (should be pre-hashed)
      defaultBalance - the starting balance for a newly created user
      Returns:
      the existing or newly created User

    • close

      public void close()
      No-op method kept for DAO interface compatibility. The shared database connection is managed centrally by DatabaseConnection.
